detail: NATIVE-FOREGROUND-ACTIVATE: Final cheap-family audit: the compositional SHELL_WORD now covers escaped and concatenated fragments, but its double-quoted ordinary branch still includes backslash instead of consuming backslash-plus-next as the sole escape unit. Use the approved pattern shape with escaped non-newline units and ordinary nonquote/nonbackslash units. Combined projection also still accepts the exact lone second tag '[quality]  [security]' because LENS_TAGS includes trailing spaces; reject equality with each stripped tag as well as a tagged prefix, and add that case to the existing mutator table. Keep all current green family cases.
